text: Sorry to bother you so late, I know you must be really busy and this is probably nothing. My stepdaughter is 10 months old and she's had a temperature of 38 tonight. Earlier this evening she was pulling herself up on the coffee table and lost her footing and bumped her forehead on the edge of it. She cried straight away, a proper loud cry, and I gave her a cuddle and she settled within a couple of minutes. Since then she's been acting completely normal, crawling around, babbling, playing with her stacking cups, ate her tea fine. Her skin and lips look their normal colour, nothing different there. There's a tiny red mark on her forehead but that's all. I just wasn't sure whether the temperature and the bump together mean I should be doing something different, or keeping her up, or if I'm worrying over nothing. Her mum's on a night shift and I don't want to ring her at work unless I need to. Again sorry for bothering you, thank you for reading this.
